recentItems.title: Congress passes funding bill to avoid October shutdown, pushing fight past midterms
recentItems.description: Congress on Tuesday voted to extend government funding until after the November midterm elections, averting a shutdown that would have begun if lawmakers failed to approve funding by Sept. 30.

recentItems.title: Trump admin. sought to deploy National Guard in immigration operations
recentItems.description: A newly revealed Department of Homeland Security memo shows the Trump administration explored a legal pathway to use National Guard troops in immigration enforcement, prompting criticism from legal experts who say the effort pushes the boundaries of federal law and long-standing limits on military involvement in domestic policing.

recentItems.title: Lindsay Clancy jury deadlocked, sent home without a verdict
recentItems.description: Jurors in the criminal trial of Lindsay Clancy were sent home Tuesday without reaching a verdict after earlier telling the judge they could not reach a unanimous decision in the case of the Massachusetts mother accused of killing her three young children in 2023.

recentItems.title: First Warning Forecast: Triple digit heat index to end the week
recentItems.description: Highs in the low 90s with a heat index to 100+. Heat index near 110 on Thursday. A cold front brings in a cool down and lower humidity for Labor Day weekend.

recentItems.title: Vick, Norfolk State eye opportunituy at Old Dominion
recentItems.description: For the first time since 2019, Norfolk State and Old Dominion will square off on the gridiron. The Spartans are coming off a shutout victory over Winston-Salem State in their opener and are gearing up for what head coach Michael Vick calls a "litmus test" against the Monarchs.

recentItems.title: Forner NFL quarterback Aaron Brooks returns to high school hallways
recentItems.description: Aaron Brooks was one of the greatest athletes to ever come out of Ferguson High School. The school was closed in 1996 and repurposed into part of Christopher Newport's Ferguson Center for the Arts, but windows into the past still remain. Brooks returned to the site of his alma mater and walked the hallways with News 3 Sports Director Marc Davis.

recentItems.title: Virginia Beach school district held in contempt for keeping records tied to racism case
recentItems.description: A judge found the district failed to destroy disciplinary records connected to Kellam High School students accused of racial harassment.

recentItems.title: Nearly a month after Portsmouth sewage spill, neighbors still seek answers on water quality
recentItems.description: Nearly a month after a 3.1 million-gallon sewage spill in Portsmouth, Douglas Avenue neighbors still have questions about water quality as HRSD continues cleanup and testing.

recentItems.title: Dare Co. Commissioners vote to remove 14 Sheriff's Office Flock cameras
recentItems.description: The national debate on Flock cameras has made its way to the Outer Banks. The Dare County Commissioners unanimously passed a resolution to remove the Flock cameras in unincorporated Dare County that the Dare County Sheriff's Office operates, at their meeting on Tuesday.
